sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.

system.description:
When forced to avoid a hostile effect through sheer agility, evasiveness or speed, you don’t disappoint. You flicker in place so quickly that you make attacks and hostile effects phase through you.

Until the beginning of your next turn, the first time each turn that you take damage, including against the triggering instance of damage, roll a d4 gaining the benefit of the result.

If you roll a 1, you gain 4 damage reduction to that instance of damage. If you roll a 2, increase the DR gained by +2, and now applies to each instance of damage until the end of the turn. If you roll a 3, same as 2 but you have resistance instead. If you roll a 4, same as 3, but you gain immunity to the triggering instance of damage.
